title: Package production
description: Builds reproducible product candidates and integrity metadata from canonical sources without changing active installations.
responsibilities: Select the supported canonical inventory and apply declared target transformations faithfully.
Generate isolated skill and CLI candidates with complete dependencies and reproducible identity.
Derive artifact metadata and assess packed CLI completeness without fabricating qualification evidence.
Produce and qualify complete browser resources within the selected CLI candidate for independent customer generation and offline reading.
owned_state: Generated candidate artifacts, their inventory and integrity metadata, and attributable production observations; canonical behavior and publication authority remain separately owned.

includes: Skill-target artifacts, product metadata, and packed CLI candidate completeness.

excludes: Installing into projects as a build side effect, asserting unexecuted checks, rewriting published artifacts, or authorizing publication.
